## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #...`
when applicable.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks actually run, with their results. Include
screenshots or a gameplay recording for visual changes. State any limitations.

- [ ] Whitespace checks pass.
- [ ] Available tests and relevant gameplay checks pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party declarations are updated where needed.
- [ ] A teammate has reviewed the change before merge.
